request.description: Records a fee payment. All breakdown amounts are validated against **concession-adjusted net totals** ΓÇö the net amount after enrollment-based concessions (firstGraduate, scheme7point5, pmss, sakthi, special) have been applied to each fee category. Attempting to pay more than the remaining net due returns HTTP 400 with a message like: `"tuition payment Γé╣X exceeds remaining concession-adjusted due Γé╣Y for Semester N (YYYY-YYYY)"`. For `paymentType=reduction`, include `reductionId` from student facility transfer API.
